title: Quarantine exports overwrite prior forensic evidence
evidence: export_quarantine_bundle uses fs::write on fixed manifest.json and graph.canonical paths (539-541), despite announcing WORM and zero historical evidence purged (502-503). Cargo.toml:105-106 registers this as babylon60-dsl.
trigger: Run two DSL programs entering quarantine from the same working directory.
impact: The second run truncates and replaces the first forensic bundle; no earlier quarantine evidence is retained.

title: BA.EXACT silently truncates non-sexagesimal fractions
evidence: When val % divisor != 0, BA.EXACT performs integer (val * 60) / divisor once and increments scale, without checking the resulting remainder.
trigger: For example NIG R0 [Y] followed by BA.EXACT R0 [YYYYYYY] computes 60/7 = 8 at scale 1.
impact: An operation advertised as exact accepts an inexact value instead of rejecting or representing the remainder; downstream arithmetic and exported evidence use the truncated value.

title: Malformed instruction operands panic past static validation
evidence: static_proof checks only label targets (132-162); ALLOC then indexes tokens[1] and tokens[2] directly (329-331), as do several other opcodes.
trigger: Invoke the registered babylon60-dsl binary on a file containing only ALLOC.
impact: An index-out-of-bounds panic bypasses controlled rejection and quarantine export.

title: Artifact global hash omits opcode and proof IR
evidence: Both canonical exporters serialize id, parents, logical timestamp, payload and signature but omit opcode (520 and 554). Normal global_hash covers only this serialization; proof.ir is written independently (593-599).
trigger: Compare a one-instruction NIG R0 [-] program with SAR R0: initial R0 is zero, both export the same event id/timestamp and R0=0 payload, but different opcode/proof IR.
impact: Different instruction semantics and proof IR can share the same manifest global_hash; that hash cannot authenticate the full declared artifact bundle.

title: Software hashes are exported as hardware-sealed TPM quotes
evidence: Lines 114-125 compute SHA256 from strings, default the signing seed to the returned hardware UUID, and label the result TPM_2_0_HARDWARE_SEALED. No TPM/SEP signing operation occurs. Consumer eu_ai_act.py:320 and :479 inserts this object into certificate/evidence packets; tracer.py:184-185 persists it for AL3 sessions.
trigger: Generate a quote with the signing seed unset, or generate any AL3/compliance evidence.
impact: The exported evidence falsely represents a reproducible software digest as hardware attestation; this does not establish a bypass of an authorization gate.

title: Notary checkpoint declares a verified quorum without contacting validators
evidence: Lines 141-161 only hash the root and construct dictionaries; the default branch reports CHECKPOINT_SEALED and 3f+1_QUORUM_VERIFIED without networking, acknowledgements, signatures, or persisted checkpoint.
trigger: Call generate_notary_checkpoint with default simulate_network_failure=False, even on a disconnected host.
impact: Callers receive a positive external-notarization claim for a root never submitted to any notary. No production admission consumer was located; the direct test in tests/test_compliance_and_attestation.py:73 exercises this public output.

title: Linux fallback discards ordinary objdump instruction lines
evidence: _disassemble_system_cli selects objdump -d at line 271, then skips every line containing a colon unless it starts with 0x (281). Ordinary objdump address lines use ADDRESS: without 0x. ELF metadata has no sections (181), so Capstone also returns empty (203-213).
trigger: Analyze an ELF file on Linux using disassemble_section.
impact: The advertised ELF disassembly and resulting CFG are empty even for a valid executable.

title: Conditional branch classification omits common branch instructions
evidence: The finite is_branch list at 229-244 excludes x86 jle/jge/ja/jae/jb/jbe and ARM b.ge/b.le/b.hi/b.ls. build_cfg only splits and links instructions marked is_branch at 342-347 and 373-385.
trigger: Disassemble code containing one of the omitted conditional branches using Capstone.
impact: CFG treats the branch as a normal instruction, omits its target edge and can merge multiple basic blocks, yielding incorrect control-flow analysis.

title: Completion endpoint returns canned legal output as model inference
evidence: Lines 146-198 choose format! strings based on model ID; gguf_model is only read for tensor_count at 144. The reply at 212-232 labels the response with the requested model and generated token usage.
trigger: Any POST to /v1/chat/completions, including with missing/unloadable GGUF or an unrelated question.
impact: Clients receive fixed legal conclusions and attested-success text rather than inference from the advertised model; conversation history other than the final content is ignored.

title: WebSocket and completion routes never invoke the instantiated authentication validator
evidence: create_router installs routes without authentication middleware (53-62); ws_handler discards AppState (238), and handle_socket acknowledges channels/RPC at 249-264 without credentials. chat_completions_handler likewise has no authentication extractor/check. main.rs 44-48 and 59-80 serves this router locally.
trigger: A local process connects to /ws or POSTs completions without supplying the dual passkey.
impact: The configured DualPasskeyAuth is unused; untrusted local clients can invoke these operations and obtain receipts. This is a localhost authorization gap, not remote network exposure.

title: SMT gate reports literal assertions as verified invariants
evidence: Lines 27-121 append True for DAG, KDA, BFT, physical and epistemic properties without inspecting their implementations; lines 197 and 215 derive SYSTEM_SOUND_AND_COMPLIANT from those flags. Only root/skills existence is checked.
trigger: Run this verifier in a workspace containing README.md and .agents, even when the claimed algorithmic properties are broken.
impact: Produces a successful verification verdict without evidence for the advertised invariants. No current workflow consumer was found in the targeted search; this finding concerns the executable verifier output itself.

title: SCITT receipt fabricates a signature and does not bind the verification results
evidence: Receipt digest hashes only invariant IDs (137-138); signature_ed25519 is a formatted string (153); Article 15 compliance is always True (150).
trigger: Generate --scitt or --json output, including a run with failed flags or changed details.
impact: Emits an object labelled cryptographic attestation although no signing occurs and result values are outside the digest. Consumers cannot authenticate the claimed results from this receipt.

title: Composite action inputs are interpolated into Bash source
evidence: Lines 38–42 directly embed inputs in run text; ifc-path, pgou-path, format and strict become shell source. format is also unquoted in the redirect.
trigger: A caller passes an input containing shell command substitution or quotes, for example an ifc-path containing $(...).
impact: Commands execute with the workflow step privileges before cortex-guard receives arguments. Pass inputs through environment variables and validate output format.

title: Bound IPC envelope length before slicing
evidence: IpcEnvelope exposes len: usize and data: [u8; 8192]; subscriber slices data[..env.len] without checking length.
trigger: A publisher on the same service sends len greater than 8192.
impact: Subscriber panics instead of returning a malformed-packet error; availability of callers using this public API can be interrupted. No internal consumer was found in targeted source search.

title: Existing-ledger integrity verdict is ignored by compiler
evidence: verify_offline_evidence returns verified/integrity_verified flags; compile_pack reads only total_entries and merkle_root at 655-658. Verifier lines 321-345 returns false with empty root for invalid ordering/version.
trigger: Compile using existing_ledger_path whose chain or sequence is invalid.
impact: Compilation can return and sign a success-shaped deliverable around rejected evidence instead of aborting; independent verifier may subsequently reject it.

title: Frozen saga proposals retain externally mutable payloads
evidence: payload is a Mapping supplied by caller, hash is recomputed from its current contents at 36; transition_to reuses the same payload object at 58.
trigger: Create a proposal from a dict then mutate that dict, including after transition_to(COMMITTED).
impact: Committed proposal content and its hash change without any state transition; frozen dataclass does not preserve evidence integrity. This is a data-contract defect, not evidence of an execution authorization bypass.

title: Optimizer resolves repository root one directory too low
evidence: parents[3] is 01_KISH_ENGINE for this file. The child is invoked as scripts/c5_thermo/exergy_optimizer_agent.py with that cwd (lines 38-40), but the assigned repository stores it at scripts/c5_thermo/exergy_optimizer_agent.py beneath the repository root. pre_push_ledger_guard.verify_exergy lines 28-36 consumes the returned False.
trigger: The repository pre-push exergy check invokes run_exergy_optimizer in a normal source checkout.
impact: Python cannot open the script under 01_KISH_ENGINE/scripts; the check returns False and prevents pushes regardless of the optimizer result.

title: Missing remote credentials produce successful fabricated task output
evidence: call returns a plain AIR-GAP MOCK string when a remote key is absent (300-305); execute_dag marks every non-LLMCallError as OK (389-398).
trigger: Run default remote SwarmOrchestrator without configured API credentials.
impact: All tasks report OK without inference; downstream consumers cannot distinguish successful work from a test substitute.

title: Formal validation recipe calls a removed Make target
evidence: The recipe invokes make verify_lean; the inspected root Makefile defines test-lean (cd proof/lean && lake build) and no verify_lean target.
trigger: Follow step 3 of the documented end-to-end demonstration.
impact: The formal validation step stops with a missing target instead of producing the promised Lean validation.

title: KL computation compares histograms with incompatible bin edges
evidence: np.histogram(point_cloud,bins=50,density=True) and np.histogram(reconstructed_cloud,bins=50,density=True) independently choose edges, then their array indices are compared as the same events.
trigger: Input and reconstructed clouds have different ranges, including translated distributions of the same shape.
impact: Reported KL can hide displaced probability mass or compare unrelated intervals; returned calibration metrics are incorrect.

title: Enterprise PoC reports success without asserting verifier outcomes
evidence: run_cmd returns returncode; lines 152 and 166 assign code but do not check it; lines 170-175 unconditionally print successful completion and compliance assertions.
trigger: The verifier incorrectly accepts the modified chain, or verification exits with an unrelated error while the ledger file exists.
impact: The example still claims successful tamper rejection and compliance, hiding the regression being demonstrated.

title: Simulated audit runner persists unconditional verified completion events
evidence: execute_vector_agent describes itself as simulation (28), reads target metadata, then emits VECTOR_AUDIT_COMPLETED with status C5_VERIFIED (36-46) and passes it to actor.append (55), without reading or auditing the target. main uses data/cib_async_ledger.db (24). Ledger actor _process serializes event.payload and inserts it into ledger_entries (ledger_actor.py 480-501, 439-454).
trigger: Run the runner with any shard entries, including nonexistent targets.
impact: The durable ledger receives completion/verification claims unsupported by an audit. The persisted payload has no explicit simulation flag, so later evidence consumers cannot distinguish these records from actual verified work by their status.

title: Extension audit targets a package path absent from this checkout
evidence: EXT_DIR is REPO_ROOT / babylon60 / extensions; caller_dirs uses the same obsolete root at 58-61. Filesystem metadata inspection found babylon60 and babylon60/extensions absent. Lines 46-48 return without a failure exit.
trigger: Run the audit from this repository layout.
impact: Skips extension reachability entirely and exits successfully, so its output cannot serve as a working pruning/quality gate.

title: Label simulated audit results instead of emitting verified passes
evidence: run_agent only awaits asyncio.sleep at 160 and returns constant PASS and silicon verification evidence at 169-172. It performs no target inspection. execute_sharur_100 writes these records and critical_fixes_attested to legion_100_audit_sitrep.json at 200-202.
trigger: Executing the script when any named audit target is absent or broken.
impact: Produces a machine-readable 100/100 passing attestation report unrelated to repository correctness; consumers may mistake simulation for measured audit evidence.

title: Anchor demo announces irreversible Bitcoin anchoring without submitting anything
evidence: run_apex_suite uses four literal simulated receipt bytes (48-53), hashes them and formats a payload; it has no transaction submission, signature verification or timestamp proof. Lines 64-65 announce an irreversible PoW sink and consummated closure.
trigger: The printed success statements are consumed as audit evidence of anchoring or hardware attestation.
impact: The demo output overstates its evidence: it only constructs bytes from simulation data and does not establish Bitcoin inclusion or hardware signatures.

title: Property tests do not exercise the engine whose concurrency they claim to check
evidence: Lines 263-267 clamp generated integers with min(c, limit), then assert the clamp is <= limit. The file imports no production BFT/KDA implementation; other tests similarly construct local dictionaries and duplicate formulas.
trigger: Change or break the production BFT concurrency limiter and run this property suite.
impact: The concurrency test remains satisfied regardless of the production limiter, so it cannot detect the stated regression; use generated DAGs against the actual engine.

title: Flagship prerequisite check prints the API token
evidence: The documented Check with shell block echoes CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN using its full current value when set.
trigger: Follow the prerequisite instructions with a real token in the environment, especially via a terminal tool whose output is logged.
impact: The credential is copied into terminal history/transcripts or agent tool output although only presence needs checking. No actual credential was read during this audit.

title: Production-labelled dispatcher returns successful work without calling providers
evidence: All three dispatch methods sleep and return fixed SUCCESS results; prompts are never sent and keys/URLs are unused. Header labels this a Production Script; the adjacent MODULE.md:90-98 describes its executable harness.
trigger: Use dispatch_task/run_swarm_campaign for a plan, context analysis, or code mutation.
impact: Results claim planning or mutation completion despite no provider inference or code effect. Scope is this shipped skill harness, not evidence of deployment elsewhere.

title: Production dispatcher returns fabricated provider successes
evidence: All three dispatch methods only asyncio.sleep then return SUCCESS and fixed result text; no provider call uses stored keys, URL, prompt or max_tokens. Header identifies Production Script.
trigger: Use dispatcher for any plan/code/deep_context task.
impact: Consumers receive successful provider/result records although no inference or code mutation occurred; misleading evidence if treated as production completion.
